t: Memorandum On Suspected Abduction Of Residents Of Yulin

pages.en:
File D. 4869.

Special Branch,
May 25, 1933.

ABDUCTION OF SUSPECTED ABDUCTION OF RESIDENTS
OF YULIN ROAD DISTRICT BY AGENTS OF THE
CHINESE AUTHORITIES.

At about 8.30 p.m. May 3, 1933, a coolie named
Ting Tien Po (丁天寶), employed by the B.A.T., residing
at No. 18, Leung Zung Li, Yulin Road, whilst passing along
the alleyway saw two male lodgers from house No. 22, led
from the back door of the house, along the alleyway to Yulin
Road and placed in a waiting motor car by two unknown male
Chinese; the car and its occupants being then driven away
in an easterly direction along Yulin Road, thence south
on Funchow Road, when it was lost sight of by the witness.

The witness Ting then reported to one Koo Woo
Sa (顧吳氏), married female, chief tenant of No.22, Leung
Zung Li, what had happened, but she did not make much of
the occurrence, and failed to report to the Police.

However, as the lodgers did not return on the
following day, she became alarmed and sent a coolie named
Lau Sam Mao (劉小毛) to Yulin Road Station at 8.45 p.m.
on May 4, to report the matter.

The Police instituted immediate enquiries and
learned that the two abducted men were Fong Chung Sang
(中華), age about 37, single, coolie, native of Ningpo,
employed at the Wan Tin Printing Co. (天一印刷公司), 222
Nanking Road, and an unknown Chinese, age about 25, native
of Ningpo, who had commenced to live in the ground floor
back room of No. 22 Leung Zung Li, on April 4, 1933.
Further information being of no assistance and insufficient
evidence, enquiries were suspended by the Divisional
O.C. pending further developments.

档案号 D. 4869。

特别处，
1933年5月25日。

关于中国当局特工涉嫌绑架榆林路地区居民一案。

1933年5月3日晚8时30分左右，受雇于英美烟草公司（B.A.T.）、居住于榆林路梁宗里18号的苦力丁天寶（Ting Tien Po），在经过弄堂时，看见两名来自梁宗里22号的男性房客被两名身份不明的中国男子从该房屋后门带出，沿弄堂行至榆林路，并被塞进一辆等候的汽车中；随后该车及车内人员沿榆林路向东行驶，随即转入福州路向南驶去，目击者此后便失去了目标踪迹。

目击者丁某随后将此事告知梁宗里22号的主租户、已婚妇女顧吳氏（Koo Woo Sa），但她并未对此事予以重视，也未向警方报告。

然而，由于房客次日未归，她感到惊慌，遂于5月4日晚8时45分派遣一名名为劉小毛（Lau Sam Mao）的苦力前往榆林路巡捕房报告此事。

警方立即展开调查，获悉两名被绑架男子分别为：方中華（Fong Chung Sang），约37岁，单身，苦力，宁波籍，受雇于南京路222号的天一印刷公司（Wan Tin Printing Co.）；以及另一名身份不明的中国男子，约25岁，宁波籍，于1933年4月4日开始居住在梁宗里22号底层后间。因进一步的信息无助于案情，且证据不足，分区警司决定暂停调查，以待事态进一步发展。

Authorities giving particulars of the abduction.

In the room occupied by the two abducted men where their two boxes which were opened in the presence of the other occupants of the house, when a quantity of old letters, name cards and two note books were found and taken to Yulin Road Station for examination. One of the note books contained an entry as follows: "Was detained in a Police Station for 10 hours on April 5th, ? year, together with Lee Tseng Ling and Loh Kwan Hyeon in connection with a meeting." Addresses found among the papers were visited, and a scrutiny of a letter made, but nothing that would throw light on the occurrence was forthcoming.

Discreet inquiries made by the Special Branch at the Bureau of Public Safety elicited the information that a public hire motor car containing four passengers was stopped at the Old West Gate on the evening of May 3 by a Search Party and taken to the Bureau for investigation, where the four passengers were identified by an agent as:-

Feng Chung-tung (馮中華), Secretary of Eastern Branch of the Communist Party.

Hsieh Ching (謝清), member of the Kiangsu Provincial Communist Party.

Lin Li-shih (林立時), Chief of the Propaganda Department of the Eastern District Branch of the Communist Party.

Li Yu-sheng (李玉生), member of the Propaganda Department of the Eastern Branch of the Communist Party.

At the time of the first arrest prisoners corresponded with that of one of the two missing men (the description being similar or identical identification is to be made).

提供绑架详情的当局。

在两名被绑架男子居住的房间内，他们的两只箱子在其他住户在场的情况下被打开，发现大量旧信件、名片和两本笔记本，这些物品被送往榆林路巡捕房进行检查。其中一本笔记本中有如下记录：“某年4月5日，因参加一次会议，与李增灵（Lee Tseng Ling）及罗观贤（Loh Kwan Hyeon）一同在警察局被拘留10小时。”警方走访了文件中发现的地址，并仔细审查了一封信件，但未能获得任何有助于澄清此案的线索。

特别处向公安局进行的秘密查询获悉，5月3日晚，一辆载有四名乘客的公共租赁汽车在老西门被搜查队拦下，并被带至公安局接受调查，四名乘客经一名特工指认为：

馮中華（Feng Chung-tung），共产党东部支部秘书。

謝清（Hsieh Ching），江苏省共产党成员。

林立時（Lin Li-shih），共产党东区支部宣传部主任。

李玉生（Li Yu-sheng），共产党东部支部宣传部成员。

在首次逮捕时，囚犯的特征与两名失踪男子中的一人相符（描述相似或相同，有待确认身份）。

made by the S.M.P. to the Public Safety Bureau by telephone
to see the prisoners. The reply was that they were sent
to Chinkiang on the evening of their arrest following
the admission of one of them of having been concerned
in Communistic activities at that place, but they were
expected back in four days when the request would be
granted.

On the afternoon of May 10, it was learned that
the prisoners had been sent back to Shanghai from Chinkiang.
On May 11, Mr. Liu was again approached as to the possibility
of interviewing the prisoners, when he replied that the
men had been remitted on the night of May 10, to Nanking
for trial. Mr. Liu Yuen Fu, Judge of the 3rd Department,
Public Safety Bureau, however, agreed to supply photographs
of the prisoners.

These photographs were obtained on May 13, and
shown to the inmates of No. 22, Loong Sung Li, Yulin Road,
and the management of the Tien Yih Printing Co. who
identified one of the photographs as that of Fung Tseong
Fung (馮中芳).

According to further information from the
Chinese Authorities, the person Fung Tseong Fung (馮中芳)
who gave his name as Fung Tseong Fung (馮中) at the
Public Safety Bureau has confessed his connection with the
Communist Party and reported, and has been engaged as an
agent in the Nanking secret service.

别名馮忠芳（Fung Tseong Fung），上海公共租界工部局警务处通过电话向公安局提出申请，要求探视囚犯。回复称，由于其中一人承认曾在镇江参与共产主义活动，他们已于被捕当晚被送往镇江，但预计四天后返回，届时将批准该请求。

5月10日下午，获悉囚犯已从镇江被押回上海。5月11日，再次向刘姓官员询问探视囚犯的可能性，他回复称，这些人已于5月10日晚被解往南京受审。然而，公安局第三科法官刘元福（Liu Yuen Fu）同意提供囚犯的照片。

这些照片于5月13日获取，并出示给榆林路龙松里（Loong Sung Li）22号的住户以及天一印刷公司的管理层，他们指认其中一张照片为馮中芳（Fung Tseong Fung）。

根据来自中国当局的进一步消息，在公安局报姓名为馮中（Fung Tseong）的馮中芳（Fung Tseong Fung）已供认其与共产党的联系，并已被聘为南京情报机构的特工。
